content:
Apple revealed the iPhone Duo today, and immediately rolled out a series of new resources to help developers prepare for the company's first foldable iPhone. Here's a summary of what's involved.

Apple shares iPhone Duo resources with developers

Apple officially unveiled the iPhone Duo at its "Surprise and Shine" event this morning. The company's first foldable phone was unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, and AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

In addition to showcasing the iPhone Duo and sharing device assets on its design resources platform, Apple has also launched a dedicated page offering a variety of resources to help developers prepare for this new foldable device.

Content includes two iPhone Duo group labs on September 16 and 17, plus Q&A sessions on photography and cameras, SwiftUI, and UIKit, each with two different time slots, scheduled for September 23.

Additionally, Apple will host iPhone Duo workshops in cities around the world, offering hands-on sessions for developers to optimise their apps and "explore adaptability between different screen sizes." These workshops will begin at the end of this month.

The "Get ready for iPhone Duo" page also lists a number of upcoming tools and documentation, including Xcode 27.1 beta, "Designing for iPhone Duo" and "Preparing your app for iPhone Duo".

The page also lists the following six videos modelled after WWDC session style:

  • Designing for iPhone Duo
  • Preparing your app for iPhone Duo
  • Level up with iPhone Duo
  • Shine with iPhone Duo adaptive layouts
  • Make the most of multiple displays and scenes on iPhone Duo
  • Build an exceptional camera experience for iPhone Duo

You can view Apple's complete developer resource kit for the iPhone Duo via this link.
